text_block_list.text:
—Spring of the Classic Year had arrived.
Though Twin Turbo's debut itself was once
deemed uncertain...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo too!
Like Turbo would ever give uuuup!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Deyaaaaaaaah!
Turbo Engine, full throootttllleee!!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo did her best!
Praise me, praise me!

Inspired by Tokai Teio, who never knew the meaning of defeat,
and supported by countless companions—

"Even if it was ungraceful, she weathered the season of trials.
From here, Twin Turbo's true challenge begins."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is finally starting.
It's a sparkling, once-in-a-lifetime
youth event, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I think I'll... pass on that, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, what's wrong?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Did something happen, you ask...?
Did you already forget?
That very first face-off between me and Tokai Teio."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio!
Tokai Teio claims a magnificent third consecutive victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Plenty of room to shake off the pursuing Umamusume!
Nice Nature somehow manages to dive into 3rd place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... They got 3 consecutive wins, and I got 3rd place!
They're both 3s, but they're totally different...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It's still way too far out of reach.
I feel embarrassed for thinking, even for a second,
that I might actually have a shot.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that did happen, didn't it?
Still!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"There's no reason to be disappointed over losing just once!
If you keep at it until you win, you'll eventually win!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Unlike you, I can't just empty my head
and magically bounce back emotionally.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She tends to get dragged along quite a bit.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind.
—I'm going on a "journey."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A journey...?

It seems Nice Nature has made up her mind
to go on an away race. Since it probably isn't overseas,
then that must mean...
choice_data_list: So you're dropping down to the local circuit?
Are you dropping down to the local circuit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Instead of going for the main Triple Crown,
I was thinking of training on the western local circuits."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Chukyo Racecourse, Kokura Racecourse...
I was thinking of touring around there to hone myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Having comrades around is reassuring, but...
I feel like I've just been leaning on them too much. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to retrain myself from scratch.
More than anything, I just want... confidence.

—Confidence. Skill aside, without the unwavering belief
that "I am absolute!",
you cannot compete on the big stage.

Nice Nature is likely still "mid-journey."
And that journey... felt necessary for her heart to grow.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Do your best then, Nature.
Turbo will be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
This spring, Turbo's gonna win
for Nature's sake too!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, you're way too overconfident.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, it's not? Isn't Turbo
supposed to do her best for Nature too?"
choice_data_list: I think the Triple Crown will be tough for Twin Turbo too

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list: Because there's a weakness in Twin Turbo's running style

text_block_list.text:
Yes, there was a major weak point
in Twin Turbo's current running style.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaaaaaah!
Haa, hah, wheeze, gah...!

Twin Turbo doesn't pace her breathing at all during
her runs. She might be able to power through in races
under 2,000 meters, but...

In the Classic Triple Crown where so many powerhouses gather,
that running style might not cut it.
It was a major concern for the future as well.

Like Nice Nature, Twin Turbo
also needs to get stronger. If so—
choice_data_list: Should Twin Turbo go on a journey too?
Wanna go on a journey too, Twin Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A journey?
Turbo doesn't wanna be left all alone!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer goes too, I guess I can go along.
But where are we going?

If Nice Nature is heading to the Western local circuit,
and considering Twin Turbo's running style...
choice_data_list: Let's head to the eastern regional track — Fukushima

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fukushima...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's a place full of memories, isn't it? For the three of us.

Yes, back before her debut.
To let Twin Turbo train freely,
the three of us took a trip to Fukushima.

"A place filled with nothing but fond memories.
And on top of that—"

Fukushima Racecourse suits Twin Turbo.
With its tight turns and short final straight, it's best suited for Twin Turbo, who lacks a burst of late speed.

It might not be a bad idea to look for hints
on how to improve my running style on a course
that's completely different from Tokyo or Nakayama.

And the question is which race to aim for.
If we're targeting a graded stakes race, there's one held in early summer—
choice_data_list: Shall we enter the "Radio NIKKEI Sho"?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The Radio NIKKEI Sho"...
If I remember right, that's an 1800m GⅢ, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I was aiming for a summer GIII race anyway.
The timing might actually be just right."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Radio NIKKEI Sho...?
So you're not running in the Classics?
Aren't you going to compete against Teio?
choice_data_list: Let's wait and see how things go with that.

text_block_list.text:
Depending on her condition, we could enter her.
However, it's probably best for Twin Turbo's sake
not to make it a set goal.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Got it! If it's okay for me to enter,
Turbo wants to go to Fukushima! And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this, Nature!
To see which of us can get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right...
The big Classic stage is still too much for me. So...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet in the fall races, Turbo!
Both of us bigger and stronger than before!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
Turbo went east, and Nature went west. The paths of the two who had run together diverged here. But...

Let us return to the grand stage without fail.
We will seize a great triumph at the Radio NIKKEI Sho.
